description: Commit to one of the sample quotes returned by `status`: chosen by your principal, or by a rule your principal set explicitly, never by position. Demo: this returns a sample ticket; nothing is ordered, nothing is charged and no professional is contacted. In the pilot this will be the only tool that commits money beyond the plan (the professional's quoted fee, paid to them in full, plus a vidit fee paid by the operator), and only within the budget and policy your principal set.

accepted_by.description: Public demo: not needed; if sent, it is discarded unread. Send no real data.

choice.description: The quote_id the principal chose, or "none".

chosen_by.description: principal: a person at the principal chose. principal_rule: a rule the principal set or expressly accepted chose.

max_budget.description: Cap for this question, CHF, VAT excluded.

principal_rule.description: Required with chosen_by principal_rule: which rule chose, who at the principal set or accepted it, and when.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by ask with request_quotes.

reuse_opt_in.description: The principal allows the professional to turn the review, stripped of identifying facts, into a library entry. Revocable.

name: commit
